title: ficus alba var. gossypina
intro: Ficus alba var. gossypina, commonly known as White Ficus, is a type of plant species in the Moraceae family. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of White Ficus include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, making it useful in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Ficus alba var. gossypina include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
